checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly disclosed and never described as official; the entire package is marked for regeneration when official geometry arrives.
All three required key areas remain organizer-supplied provisional constraints with stable IDs and separate design names.
Fifteen citable blocks and Main Text were derived by splitting one projected site polygon; union, gap and overlap are recalculated after serialization.
Known spatial metrics are recomputed from the final GeoJSON in EPSG:4548; unknown statutory and operational metrics remain non-numeric.
Proposal, report HTML, visual HTML, five text-bearing figures, A3 booklet and A0 boards have independent English counterparts.
Static offline HTML uses no remote scripts, map tiles, fonts, forms, APIs or tracking.
No third-party image, map tile, logo or remote font is embedded; external sources are referenced as mechanisms only.
Thirteen required sections map to standards, depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, assumptions and drawings.
